objective: Reduce control-room alarm verification workload by 30% without increasing missed critical incidents.
solution: Integrate AI-assisted alarm verification with the existing VMS and control-room workflow. Keep human control of critical alarm handling.
decision_question: Is this a viable paid pilot candidate, and which acceptance tests and evidence are needed before approaching a customer?
success_criteria: Observe at least a 30% reduction in operator verification minutes against a matched baseline.
Demonstrate no increase in missed critical incidents against the same baseline, with a pre-agreed sample and measurement protocol.
Validate integration, operator handover and cost against written pilot acceptance conditions.
constraints: Treat 30% as a project target, not a measured result.
Preserve critical escalation and customer-authorised data handling.

evidence.claim: The 30% workload reduction is a proposed target. No measured outcome is available.
A labelled alarm sample, missed-incident baseline, VMS validation and commercial commitments have not been supplied.
